title: Open new Projects with a chosen layout
body:
Add the New Project layout: one global definition slot in project-layouts.json, set with Use for new Projects in the picker, shown and reset to Single terminal in Settings. Opening a Project from a directory applies it through the normal Apply path.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md (section: New Projects)
Blocked by: cplsbf - Add project layout picker and Save controls
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- The slot is a copy, not a reference; editing/deleting the source layout leaves it unchanged. Unset means one tiled terminal, as today.
- Opening a Project applies it via Filling missing slots (first terminal takes the first terminal slot; fresh terminals run no command, start no agent). The new Project's picker shows Custom.
- Startup workspace restore never applies the slot. Writes use the reload-merge-write path.
- Test first; screenshot the picker action, the Settings row, and a Project opened with a mixed layout. Update docs/project-layouts.md. This completes the manual-layout milestone.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
